mentions.name: Go Micro
mentions.description: An open source Go microservices framework. Development has been revived and the v5 CLI and API rewritten from scratch, aiming to rebuild value around the framework after the VC-funded company behind it wound down and alienated the community.
mentions.problem: The VC-funded company behind the tools veered in a direction that alienated the community, creating confusion; with the company dead, there's an opportunity to rebuild value around the Go Micro framework.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have revived my work on Go Micro (https://github.com/micro/go-micro) and rewritten the v5 cli/api from scratch (https://github.com/micro/micro). As a VC funded company there was a lot of confusion around the tools we were building and we veered off in a direction that alienated the community.
